hooks.command: fail_closed() { printf '%s\n' "Codex deny floor unavailable: $1" >&2; exit 2; }; expected='55a9db7c1aa5b8d3a73a887dc96f04b949397e2d3afc9dec8eb6468386eecd04'; [ -n "${HOME:-}" ] || fail_closed 'HOME is unavailable'; dispatcher=$HOME/.claude/hooks/dispatch.py; [ -f "$dispatcher" ] || fail_closed 'shared dispatcher is missing'; actual=$(python3 -c "import hashlib,pathlib,sys; p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); print(hashlib.sha256(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').encode('utf-8')).hexdigest())" "$dispatcher") || fail_closed 'could not verify shared dispatcher identity'; [ "$actual" = "$expected" ] || fail_closed 'shared dispatcher identity mismatch'; exec python3 "$dispatcher" --event pre --runtime codex
hooks.commandWindows: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; function F([string]$r){[Console]::Error.WriteLine(('Codex deny floor unavailable: {0}' -f $r));exit 2}; try{$e='55a9db7c1aa5b8d3a73a887dc96f04b949397e2d3afc9dec8eb6468386eecd04';if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:USERPROFILE)){F 'USERPROFILE is unavailable'};$d=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.claude\hooks\dispatch.py';if(!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $d -PathType Leaf)){F 'shared dispatcher is missing'};$t=[IO.File]::ReadAllText($d).Replace([Environment]::NewLine,[string][char]10);$b=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false).GetBytes($t);$s=[Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create();try{$a=[BitConverter]::ToString($s.ComputeHash($b)).Replace('-','').ToLowerInvariant()}finally{$s.Dispose()};if($a -cne $e){F 'shared dispatcher identity mismatch'};$p=Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'py.exe';if(!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf)){F 'Python launcher is missing'};& $p -3 $d --event pre --runtime codex;exit $LASTEXITCODE}catch{F 'launcher error'}
